description: One benchmark from the handyai.news benchmark board: every model's latest reported score with its rank, maker, setting and the Model Drop it came from, plus the record score over time (who held first place when). Use it to answer "which model is best at X" and cite the source drop. Comes with a shareable PNG of the leaderboard (image_url); set include_image to get it inline.

benchmark.description: The benchmark's name or slug, e.g. "Terminal-Bench", "DeepSWE", "GDPval", "OSWorld".

include_image.description: Also return the leaderboard card as an inline PNG image. Default false; the PNG URL is always in image_url.

range.description: Only scores from Model Drops published in this window. Default: all.

name: get_benchmark
title: Get a benchmark leaderboard
